senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָשַׁק)withholding what is due to one’s neighbor, oppression. Sifra K’dosh., ch. III, Par. 2 (ref. to Lev. XIX, 13) אף ע׳ דבר של ממון ‘osheḳ likewise (like גזל) refers to money matters (not to personal injury).
units: B. Mets. 111ᵃ (interch. with עשק) לך ושוב … זהו ע׳ וכ׳ saying, go and come again (for thy wages &c.), that is ‘osheḳ; I have what is due to thee, but I will not give it thee, that is gazel (robbery).

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 111a:16">Ib.</cite> <he>איזהו ע׳ שחייבה וכ׳</he> what withholding is it for which the Law requires a sacrifice (<cite ref="Leviticus 5:21">Lev. V, 21</cite> sq.)? <he>דכפר ליה ממונא</he> when one denies owing money.
Ib. זהו ע׳ זהו גזל ‘osheḳ and gazel are the same; Yalk. Lev. 605.

<cite ref="Bava Metzia 48a:4">B. Mets. 48ᵃ</cite> <he>יחד לו כלי לעשקו</he> he assigned to him an object (as security) for the wages withheld from him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 479:9">Yalk. Lev. 479</cite> <he>לעושקו</he>; a. fr.
